umf.postgresql.source:
-- Unexecuted original language-frontier lookup; admitted unique oid[] <=256.
SELECT l.tableoid::pg_catalog.oid::pg_catalog.text AS catalog_class_oid,
       l.oid::pg_catalog.text AS object_oid,
       l.lanacl::pg_catalog.text AS lanacl_native_text,
       pg_catalog.array_dims(l.lanacl) AS lanacl_native_dimensions,
       pg_catalog.to_jsonb(l)::pg_catalog.text AS original_catalog_row_json
FROM pg_catalog.pg_language AS l
WHERE l.oid = ANY ($1::pg_catalog.oid[])
ORDER BY l.oid;
